opening.argument: The material presents a rewards program with identifiable steps: viewers are directed to sign up, complete a profile, confirm an email, rate upcoming movies or test new apps, and complete offers. It describes points and cash from those activities as a route to a Best Buy gift card. Those instructions and promotional images support the ordinary rewards-and-promotions reading: the claimed benefit is tied to participation in stated activities. They do not, however, verify the external destination, establish any affiliation with Best Buy, or show that a gift card was actually received. The presentation supports what the program claims to offer, not a conclusion about its safety or fulfillment.
